desc: For hunting and high-volume shooting and plinking with your favorite rimfire handgun and rifle, Fiocchi offers several different loads for your rimfire firearms. Known for consistent quality at an economical price, Fiocchi 22's allow you to shoot for lots of fun or hunting without having to deal with the problems of cheaper rimfire ammo such as duds, fail to function, excessive powder fouling, etc. Many shooters tell Fiocchi they are able to get match accuracy from their hunting rifles.
